lead: Tax, invoices, currencies, contract length and what counts as a user. Shown as an accordion or as an open list in up to three columns.
note: The note gives the date of the answers and what overrides them.

questions.title: The accordion uses native HTML
questions.bodytext: Each row is a details element. The browser handles opening, keyboard use and printing, so it works without JavaScript.

questions.title: Opening one row closes the rest
questions.bodytext: A shared name attribute does this, without any script. Each FAQ has its own name, so two FAQs on one page work independently.

questions.title: The open list has nothing to click
questions.bodytext: The same questions and answers in up to three columns. Use it when readers should see every answer at once.

questions.title: Answers are rich text
questions.bodytext: Editors can add a paragraph, a list or a link without a new field for each case.
